title: The fence that fought the wind

lines.text: A farmer built a fence to stop the wind, and it made everything worse.
His hat kept blowing away, so he built it taller.
Taller. Then taller again. And still the hat flew.
Because a solid wall doesn't stop wind. It makes it spin.
The air curls over the top and slams down behind it, twice as hard.
Then one gust grabbed the whole fence, farmer included.
The fix? Leave gaps. Comment fence and I'll send you the numbers.
